info.title: b*nature API
info.description: Organization-scoped REST API. Cookie session required except health. Set X-Organization-Id to select an authorized organization.

get.description: Authorized PDF payment confirmation. Contains immutable payment and allocation data; no legal certification.
Prepared reminder draft for manual delivery. Does not send email.

post.description: Controlled backfill, at most 100 unbooked payments per operation. Repeat with a new key while remaining > 0.
Opens a fiscal year with inclusive date boundaries (calendar year by default). Without openingBalances, balances are carried forward from the closed previous year.
Irreversibly closes a fiscal year. Later corrections are booked in an open year.
Posts an immutable income or expense entry. Membership fees are booked from payments instead.
Reverses a payment: its allocations stop counting and a booked cashbook entry is reversed atomically.
Organization-defined report structure. Not an official or certified template.

get.description: Authorized annual income/expense report. No legal certification.

post.description: Raw file body (PDF, PNG or JPEG, max. 10 MiB). Metadata as base64url JSON in X-Document-Metadata.
Adds an immutable new file version. Metadata: {"filename": "..."}.

get.description: Authorized private download. The stored SHA-256 is verified before delivery.

post.description: Raw file body (PDF, PNG or JPEG, max. 10 MiB). Metadata as base64url JSON in X-Document-Metadata.
Adds an immutable new file version. Metadata: {"filename": "..."}.

get.description: Authorized private download. The stored SHA-256 is verified before delivery.
Existing persons (members or not) that can be registered as volunteers.

post.description: Creates an unconfirmed time draft from recorded attendance. Drafts never count as hours.

get.description: Indicative assignment check per volunteer. Never a legal confirmation of insurance cover.
Recomputes the hash chain of both register sections.

post.description: Finalizes an immutable register state with SHA-256 checksum. Status starts as signature pending.
Imports an externally signed file (PAdES PDF or CAdES .p7m) or an RFC 3161 timestamp into the private document store. Metadata: {"kind":"signed|timestamp","filename":"..."}.
Documents the result of an external signature/timestamp verification. Not a certification.
Creates a rule or a new version of an existing rule key; the current version is closed.
Calculates deadlines from the active rule versions. Existing deadlines are kept.
